headline.title: Unlocking Britain’s next era of productivity: Building a nation of AI trailblazers
headline.summary: The article discusses the potential for artificial intelligence to enhance productivity in Britain by fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration among various professional roles. It emphasizes the importance of building a workforce adept in AI technologies to drive economic growth and competitiveness.

articles.title: Vibe coding platform Base44 launches own model as AI startups seek defensibility
articles.summary: Wix-owned vibe coding platform Base44 has launched its own AI model, aiming to achieve superior performance compared to existing frontier models. This move reflects a broader trend among AI startups seeking to establish defensibility in a competitive market.

articles.title: Crypto exchange OKX wants AI agents to hire and pay each other
articles.summary: Crypto exchange OKX is developing a marketplace where AI agents can hire and pay each other, integrating payments, identity, and reputation systems. This initiative aims to facilitate autonomous transactions and interactions among AI entities.

articles.title: US offers $10 million for info on group behind Signal and WhatsApp hacking spree
articles.summary: The U.S. government has announced a $10 million reward for information leading to the identification of the Russian state-sponsored groups responsible for a hacking spree targeting Signal and WhatsApp, which has been active since at least March. This initiative aims to combat ongoing cyber threats linked to these groups.

articles.title: Ask an AI expert: What exactly is the full stack?
articles.summary: The article explores the concept of full-stack AI infrastructure, detailing the various components and layers involved in developing and deploying AI systems. It highlights the integration of hardware, software, and data management necessary for effective AI implementation.

articles.title: MER-R1: Multimodal Emotion Reasoning via Slow-Fast Thinking Synergy
articles.summary: The study introduces MER-R1, a framework for multimodal emotion reasoning that highlights the effectiveness of fast thinking over slow reasoning in improving accuracy in emotion recognition tasks. Findings indicate that while explicit reasoning enhances interpretability, rapid responses yield better recall and broader predictions.

articles.title: JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC) V1: An Industrial-Scale LLM/VLM-Centric Solution for Item Understanding, Management, and Applications
articles.summary: JD.com has introduced the JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC) V1, a large-scale solution designed to enhance item understanding, management, and applications across its extensive e-commerce platform. The initiative aims to address challenges in producing high-quality structured item knowledge to improve consumer experience and operational efficiency.

articles.title: Not All Relations Rotate Alike: Transformation-Aware Decoupling for Viewpoint-Robust 3D Scene Graph Generation
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach to 3D Scene Graph Generation (3DSGG) that addresses the limitations of existing models in maintaining consistent object relations when viewed from different yaw angles. The proposed method, termed transformation-aware decoupling, aims to enhance viewpoint robustness in generating structured object-relation-object graphs for improved spatial understanding in embodied intelligence applications.

articles.title: CoIn: Comprehensive 2D-3D Inpainting with Gaussian Splatting Guidance
articles.summary: The article introduces CoIn, a new framework designed for comprehensive 2D-3D inpainting that integrates Gaussian Splatting guidance. This method addresses limitations of existing techniques by enabling efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes without relying on precise segmentation masks, thus expanding its applicability beyond object removal tasks.

articles.title: KG2Cypher: Data-Centric Pipeline for Building Enterprise Text-to-Cypher Systems
articles.summary: KG2Cypher is a data-centric pipeline designed to create text-to-Cypher systems for enterprise Knowledge Graphs, facilitating natural-language interfaces for internal search and analytics. The system constructs executable Cypher queries from existing graph data and employs large language models to generate corresponding natural language queries.

articles.title: S$^2$-VLA: State-Space Guided Vision-Language-Action Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
articles.summary: The article presents S$^2$-VLA, a new model designed to enhance Vision-Language-Action (VLA) capabilities for long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks by utilizing state-space guidance. This approach aims to mitigate performance degradation caused by cumulative error propagation in traditional static feature fusion methods.

articles.title: Reflect-R1: Evidence-Driven Reflection for Self-Correction in Long Video Understanding
articles.summary: The article presents Reflect-R1, a novel approach to long video understanding that incorporates evidence-driven reflection to enhance self-correction capabilities. By addressing the limitations of existing multimodal reflection mechanisms, the model aims to reduce blind confidence and improve error correction in video analysis.
